response.description: Azure Compute Spot plus, now in public preview, is an enhanced tier of Azure Spot Virtual Machines, bringing greater runtime consistency and earlier eviction signals to interruption-tolerant workloads.Standard Spot suits highly resilient workloads focused on savings. Spot plus offers more predictability and time to respond to interruptions.Key capabilities:Targets at least 60 minutes of runtime on a best-effort basis, while remaining evictableIf Azure evicts a Spot plus VM to reclaim capacity within the first 60 minutes, you aren't charged for that VM's usageUp to 2 minutes' eviction notice to checkpoint or drain workRebalance notifications, typically 30 seconds to 15 minutes ahead, signal elevated eviction riskSpot plus costs more than standard Spot and remains well below pay-as-you-go pricing. Deploy through the Compute API, ARM templates, Azure portal, Azure CLI, Azure PowerShell and Azure SDKs, on single-instance VMs and Virtual Machine Scale Sets with Flexible or Uniform orchestration.Register your subscription for the Spot plus preview feature and deploy a VM or scale set with SpotPlus priority using API version 2026-04-01 or later.Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Azure Compute Spot plus
